props.name: source
props.comment: The form field holding the GeoJSON value.

props.name: kind
props.comment: The kind of value the field holds, which decides what a drawing writes.

props.name: label
props.comment: The legend. A string is translated; `false` renders none.

props.name: validate
props.comment: Runs after the limits below. Read once.

props.name: minVertices
props.comment: Fewest vertices the shape may have; a polygon ring counts its distinct vertices. The shape is stored as drawn and the field is flagged. Read once.

props.name: maxVertices
props.comment: Most vertices the shape may have. Read once.

props.name: minAreaM2
props.comment: Smallest area in square metres a polygon may cover. Read once.

props.name: allowSelfIntersection
props.comment: Set to false to flag a shape that crosses itself. Defaults to true, which checks nothing. Read once.

props.name: tools
props.comment: The toolbar buttons, in order. Defaults to the tools that suit `kind`.

props.name: snappable
props.comment: Snap to existing coordinates and lines. Read once. Defaults to true.

props.name: snapDistance
props.comment: Pixels within which the pointer grabs a vertex or snaps. Read once. Defaults to 20.

props.name: disabled
props.comment: Shows the shape and hides the toolbar; pan and zoom still work.

props.name: defaultCenter
props.comment: `[lat, lng]`. The map centre while the field is empty. Defaults to `[0, 0]`.

props.name: zoom
props.comment: Read once at mount. Defaults to 13.

props.name: height
props.comment: In pixels, or any CSS length. Defaults to 300.

props.name: mapStyle
props.comment: Defaults to the style from `MapsProvider`.

props.name: shapeStyle
props.comment: Partial over `DEFAULT_SHAPE_STYLE`. Read once.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.comment:
Width over height of a `BBox` value. The stored box grows around its centre
to this ratio and never shrinks, and the rectangle on the map follows it.

props.name: fitBounds
props.comment: Frame the first value on the map. The user's own edits never refit. Defaults to true.

props.name: refine
props.type: ((value: ShapeValue, options: { signal: AbortSignal; }) => ShapeValue | Promise<ShapeValue | null> | null)
props.comment:
Adjusts the value after the user's own drawing or edit, such as snapping a
line to roads. It runs once the edit is in the form, never on load or
reset, and a newer edit or an unmount aborts `signal`. A result that is
not null and differs is written, unless the field changed meanwhile. A
thrown error keeps the value as drawn. A null result is "nothing to
change" unless `refineFailedMessage` is set, which a throw also notifies.

props.name: refineFailedMessage
props.comment:
Message key notified as a warning when `refine` resolves to null or throws
(an abort excepted), and the value is kept as drawn. `LineStringInput` sets it for
`snapToRoads`.
